evidence: Target displays an in-line clear bin, two-tier radial cyclones, and legible 'dyson v15 detect total clean' text on the wand.
Absence of a red push-button power switch on the body distinguishes it from the V12 Detect Slim.

candidate_checks.evidence: Full-size in-line bin, cyclone configuration, and readable wand label confirm V15 Detect.
Lacks the red push-button power switch on the cyclone body and has larger bin proportions.
V8 features a perpendicular bin and cyclone layout rather than this in-line stick vacuum structure.
Big Ball is a corded cylinder canister vacuum, not an in-line cordless stick vacuum.
Lacks the distinct CleanCompaktor mechanism and dual conical brush rollers of the V16.
WashG1 is an upright hard floor wet cleaner with water tanks rather than a dry cyclone vacuum.
